name: desert-road
title: Drumul prin pustiu (două chilii)
units: engine units (figure 4.2 tall), three.js Y-up, +Z towards the usual camera

cell1.note: in front of the door, facing out (towards the road)

cell1-door.note: standing in the doorway, facing out (enter / leave the cell)

cell2.note: in front of the door, facing out (towards the road)

cell2-door.note: standing in the doorway, facing out (enter / leave the cell)

far-left.note: far left on the road (facing the camera side +Z; turn with face)

road-a.note: on the road, left of the middle (facing the camera side +Z; turn with face)

road-mid.note: middle of the road (facing the camera side +Z; turn with face)

road-b.note: on the road, right of the middle (facing the camera side +Z; turn with face)

far-right.note: far right on the road (facing the camera side +Z; turn with face)

stones.note: on the road just behind the stone patch, facing it (+Z): a basket dropped here lands on the stones

offstage-left.note: out of frame, left end of the road (enter walking +X)

offstage-right.note: out of frame, right end of the road (enter walking -X)

offstage-front.note: out of frame towards the camera

palm-shade.note: in the shade of the back palms, facing the camera

acting.clear: no decoration within 0.6 of the road / paths, 2.2 of anchors, 6.2 of the cells, 3 of the stone patch

wide.note: both cells, the road and the stones

stones.note: close on the stone patch / basket drop

reverse.note: from between the cells towards the open desert

notes: Collision: col:cell1/col:cell2 (closed walls), col:palmN, col:rockN, col:bushN, col:stoneN (big stones of the patch), col:cellN-jar. The doors are separate nodes door:cell1 / door:cell2 with the origin on the hinge (rotate about +Y to open, negative angle opens outwards to the right). Ground meshes: ground (core, unique texture) and ground_far (dunes); both are walkable and raycastable. Decoration is never on the road / paths.
